glosses: To shake, quiver, or vibrate.

examples.text: Thou beleeuest that there is one God, thou doest well: the deuils also beleeue, and tremble.

glosses: A shake, quiver, or vibration.

examples.text: The earthquake shook the building.

examples.text: Shaking his head, he kept repeating “No, no, no”.
